name: app-core-banking-dashboard-flow-sheet-with-italic-serif-headline
title: Core Banking Flow Sheet with Italic Serif Headline
whatItIs: A tall pale sheet with a Core Banking pill, a headline 'One Dashboard, Every Financial Move.' with italic serif, four tag pills and phones laid out in a flow: home, transactions, send money, confirm transfer, add money, add money keypad, pay bills, provider list, payment confirmation and bill paid.
whatItMeans: Laying out related screens in a staggered flow shows the whole journey, and a shared blue-grey gradient unifies them.
techniques: Staggered rows of phones showing a flow
Bottom sheets rising over blurred screens
Serif italic accent in the headline
Tag pills for the four main actions

vocabulary.definition: A page of screens arranged to show a journey.
A panel rising from the bottom over a dimmed screen.
A numeric pad with semi-transparent keys.
